habitat: Open woodland edges, farmland, moorland, reedbeds and marshes, parks and gardens; up to 3800 m
description: Slim slate-grey cuckoo with barred white underparts, long tail and yellow eye-ring, bill base and feet (female sometimes rufous morph); summer breeding visitor, a brood parasite laying in the nests of small passerines (notably reed warblers and meadow pipits); famous two-note "cu-coo" call.
